Apple strudel is a traditional Viennese strudel, a popular pastry in Austria, Switzerland, Bavaria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Italy, and other countries in Europe. It doesn’t matter where you live, you will love it! Ingredients Strudel dough: • 1/3 cup lukewarm water (80 ml / 80 g) • 1 tablespoon + ½ teaspoon neutral tasting vegetable oil (15 g) • ½ teaspoon vinegar (or lemon juice) • 1/8 teaspoon fine salt • 145 g bread flour (about 1 cup) (it works with all purpose flour too) • ½ teaspoon vegetable oil for brushing the dough • flour for dusting Apple filling: • 3 tablespoons unsalted butter (40 g) • 2/3 cups fine, dry bread crumbs (80 g) • 5 tablespoons granulated sugar (65 g) • ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon • 4 tablespoons raisins (50 g) • 3 tablespoons rum for soaking the raisins  • 2 lbs sweet-tart apples (900 g to 1 kg) (e.g. MacIntosh)  • 1 tablespoon lemon juice • 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing the dough (divided) • confectioner’s sugar for dusting • whipped cream for serving

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

videos.caption: Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

HEALTHIER banana bread choco chip cookies 🍌🍪 1/2 cup salted butter 1/3 cup maple syrup 1 medium ripe banana, mashed well 1 large egg  1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1 3/4 cups almond flour 1 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp salt 2/3 cup of chocolate chips Sea salt to top Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir continuously until its bubbling and browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and let cool for 20 minutes. Add the cooled browned butter, maple syrup and banana to a large bowl and whisk until smooth. Whisk in the egg and vanilla until combined. Fold in the almond flour, baking soda and salt until fully combined. The dough should be wet almost like a banana bread batter. Transfer to the fridge to firm up for 15 minutes while the oven preheats.  Preheat oven to 375F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Fold in the chocolate chips until just combined. Scoop 12 cookies onto the baking sheet. Bake for 8-11 minutes until outsides are golden and center is still soft. Let cool for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack. #bananabreadcookies #chocolatechipcookie #brownbuttercookies #brownbutterbananabreadcookies #brownbutterchocolatechipcookies

Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. Cook the ground beef on medium heat. Once browned, add minced garlic and all the seasonings. Stir for a minute. Set aside.  2. Preheat oven to 375F 3. Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles These Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles are an easy, flavorful dinner. This is a quick dinner the whole family will love! Thank you for the inspo @britscookin 🫶 Ingredients 1 lb ground beef 4 packages ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded (about 10–12 oz) Salt and black pepper, to taste 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 1 head broccoli, cut into florets 1/3 cup water, for steaming broccoli Mongolian Sauce 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/3 cup brown sugar 2 tbsp hoisin sauce 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tsp fresh ginger paste  1 tsp sesame oil 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, optional Cornstarch Slurry 1 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp cold water Directions 1. Add the ground beef to a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain any excess grease if needed. 2. Add the mushrooms and broccoli into the skillet.  3. Add 1/3 of water to the skillet and cover to let the broccoli steam for a few minutes.  4. While the broccoli is steaming, cook the ramen noodles according to the package directions, leaving out the seasoning packets. Drain and set aside. 5. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. 6. Pour the Mongolian sauce over the beef, mushrooms, and broccoli. Stir until everything is well combined. 7. Whisk together the cornstarch and cold water. Pour the slurry into the skillet and let everything simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. 8. Add the cooked ramen noodles and toss until everything is coated in the sauce. #EasyRecipe #DinnerIdeas #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #easydinner

School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

If you need an easy dinner recipe using a pound of ground beef, this Sloppy Joe Potato Skillet won’t disappoint!  INGREDIENTS  5 small/medium potatoes olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (for potatoes) 1 lb ground beef  1 chopped onion  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper  1 tsp onion powder and paprika  1 tbsp minced garlic  1-2 tbsp Worcestershire  8 oz can tomato sauce  1/4 cup ketchup  1 tbsp mustard  2 tbsp bbq sauce  1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Peel, wash, and cut potatoes up into cubes.  Toss them with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  Cook the potatoes in the air fryer at 400 degrees F for about 20-25 minutes shaking them around at least a couple of times while they cook.  Once the potatoes are cooking, brown the ground beef and onion in a skillet and add all seasonings.  Add minced garlic, Worcestershire, tomato sauce, ketchup, mustard, and bbq sauce. Let simmer on low until the potatoes are ready.  Add crispy potatoes to the skillet with the sloppy joe mix and give it a quick stir. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and put in the oven under broil just to melt the cheese.  Enjoy! #easyrecipes #dinner #sloppyjoes

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

High Protein Cheesy Honey Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas🔥🍯🍗 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 10 Total) 484 Calories 33C | 14gF | 65gP Ingredients: 1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1.5 Packets Chipotle Seasoning (homemade or Cholula Chipotle Seasoning) 1 Tsp Olive Oil 400g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 2 Tsp Chipotle Seasoning (Cholula) 80ml Light Mayonnaise (Heinz) 2 Garlic Cloves 1/2 Juiced Lime 2 Tsp Chipotle In Adobo Sauce (La Costena) 80ml Buffalo Sauce (Franks Redhot Buffalo Sauce) 100g Honey 40g Light Grated Cheese Diced Chives 10 Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese - per quesadilla) Directions: 1. Start by seasoning your chicken breast with chipotle seasoning, olive oil & mix. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken with a lid for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side or until fully cooked through, once cooked shred the chicken apart using 2 forks. 3. In a blender cup add low fat cottage cheese, chipotle seasoning, light mayonnaise, garlic, lime juice, chipotle in adobo sauce, buffalo sauce, honey & blend for 2 minutes until smooth & creamy. 4. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Place a warm tortilla down & to one half add a layer of cheese followed by 1/10th of the filling, another layer of cheese & fold. 6. Toast on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas.  #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor.
